profileAudit.selectionPolicy: Use the smallest explicitly named size or lightest same-size plate; use complete assemblies when a product requires multiple parts; never select a mount, plug, stopper, spacer, screw, or add-on as the product itself. Keep only selected variants at or below 500 g. Profiles without a size-to-weight mapping are explicitly marked unresolved rather than described as confirmed minimum-size selections.
